We need to find a retrosynthetic template that when applied to the given molecule (initial_molecule) reproduces the reaction: carboxylic acid to amide via coupling agent. The forward reaction: carboxylic acid + amine -> amide, breaking C-O (carboxylic acid) and forming C-N. In retrosynthesis, we need to break amide bond to give carboxylic acid and amine fragments.

We need to search template catalog for templates that break aliphatic carboxylic acid (i.e., functional group broken: aliphatic carboxylic acid) and form C-N bond. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_broken=["aliphatic carboxylic acid"], functional_groups_formed maybe ["amide"]? But criteria expects functional groups formed in forward reaction. In forward reaction, amide is formed, carboxylic acid broken. So functional_groups_broken=["aliphatic carboxylic acid"], functional_groups_formed=["amide"].

Let's call search_template_catalog_by_criteria.
